body.name: Smallest assignment-coupled rank pattern
body.construction: Take \(m=3\), \(N=2\), \(L=\{(1,1),(2,2),(3,3),(1,2),(2,3),(3,1)\}\), and let the own-treatment vectors of states \(1,2,3\) be \((0,0)\), \((1,0)\), and \((0,1)\), respectively, at the common exposure \(e\). The three assignment-specific rank comparisons entering \(T\) compare \(\theta_1(0,e)\) with \(\theta_2(0,e)\), \(\theta_1(1,e)\) with the same \(\theta_2(0,e)\), and the same \(\theta_1(0,e)\) with \(\theta_2(1,e)\). Shared-potential-outcome equalities identify the repeated coordinates across states, while the two exceedance indicators constrain \(\theta_u(1,e)-\theta_u(0,e)>c\).
